question: A CV-screening tool is classified high-risk under Art 6(2) and Annex III. From which date do the Chapter III requirements apply to it?
verdict_rationale: Art 113(c)(i) applies Chapter III Sections 1-3 from 2 December 2027 as regards AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(2) and Annex III. Art 113(c)(ii) (2 August 2028) is the distractor: it covers Art 6(1)/Annex I systems.

question: A machine-safety component is classified high-risk under Art 6(1) and Annex I. From which date do the Chapter III requirements apply?
verdict_rationale: Art 113(c)(ii) applies Chapter III Sections 1-3 from 2 August 2028 as regards AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(1) and Annex I. Art 113(c)(i) (2 December 2027) is the distractor: it covers Art 6(2)/Annex III systems.

question: A synthetic-content generator was placed on the market in June 2026, before the Act applied. By when must its provider comply with the Art 50(2) marking rule?
verdict_rationale: Art 111(4) requires providers of synthetic-content systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 to comply with Art 50(2) by 2 December 2026. Art 111(3) (GPAI models, 2 August 2027) is the distractor: it covers general-purpose AI models, not synthetic-content systems.

question: A GPAI model was placed on the market in March 2025. By when must its provider comply with the GPAI obligations, and which duties apply?
verdict_rationale: Art 111(3) requires providers of GPAI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 to comply with the GPAI obligations (Art 53 duties) by 2 August 2027. Art 111(4) (synthetic content, 2 December 2026) is the distractor.

question: A prohibited-practice system (Art 5(1) first subparagraph, excluding points ba/bb) was already in use before the Act applied. From which date does the prohibition apply to it?
verdict_rationale: Art 113(a) applies Chapters I and II from 2 February 2025, with the exception of Art 5(1) points (ba)/(bb) and Art 5(1a)/(1b) which apply from 2 December 2026. The first-subparagraph prohibition (other than ba/bb) applies from 2 February 2025. Art 113(b) (2 August 2025) is the distractor.
